exact_theorem.band_identity: For each cutoff c, T=B_c+(T-B_c) entrywise on the finite window.
exact_theorem.common_normalization: The full-window square-energy geometry is shared by T and every Bcutoff.
exact_theorem.cutoff_nestedness: The masks are predeclared and nested as c increases from 0 to 3.
exact_theorem.geometry: The full-window geometry is a finite sum of nonnegative rational squares.
exact_theorem.rayleigh_identity: For the selected full eigenvector, band and tail Rayleigh terms sum to lambda.
